decisions.chosen: World Bank world real GDP, NY.GDP.MKTP.KD, constant 2015 US$
decisions.detail: user: Metric 3 plan, world output between GTA 5 and GTA 6; same price basis as Metric 2's per-capita series
user: bookended by the GTA 5 and GTA 6 releases (17 Sep 2013, 19 Nov 2026)

decisions.decision: Years the World Bank has not published
decisions.chosen: last published GDP grown by IMF WEO world real GDP growth, no population adjustment, flagged is_estimate
decisions.detail: fct_world_productivity carries the unpublished year with the same IMF chain; total output takes no per-capita adjustment

decisions.chosen: spread evenly over the year's days (365 or 366)
decisions.detail: GDP is published yearly; no seasonality is claimed

decisions.decision: Which day a milestone's output is read on
decisions.chosen: the running total through the day before the event
decisions.detail: user: Metric 3 plan; avoids arguing about events late in the UTC day
user: Metric 3 plan; the day before GTA 5 lies outside the wait, and nothing has been made since GTA 5 yet

decisions.chosen: the nine flagged is_editorial: comet, AlphaGo, RDR2, black hole, vaccine, ChatGPT, GTA 6 trailer, Claude Code, Artemis II
decisions.detail: user named the milestones to keep on the chart and asked for Claude Code

decisions.chosen: 2025-02-24, the research-preview launch beside Claude 3.7 Sonnet
decisions.detail: first public release; general availability (2025-05-22) is kept in why
user: bookended by the two releases; GTA 6 unlocks 2026-11-19 00:00 UTC, the site countdown's moment

decisions.chosen: a range() of days generated in SQL, not metricflow_time_spine
decisions.detail: the time spine covers 2025-2027 only; widening it would change a model Metric 1 reads

decisions.decision: Running total across an unavailable day
decisions.detail: AGENTS.md: a NULL is unavailable, never zero; a total that skipped a year would understate

decisions.chosen: World Bank GDP per person employed and GDP per capita, world aggregate, real
decisions.detail: user: productivity measured by actual economic indexes (GDP per capita) for the whole world, economic data only
user: bookended by the GTA 5 and GTA 6 releases (17 Sep 2013, 19 Nov 2026)

decisions.decision: Years the World Bank has not published
decisions.chosen: per capita carried by IMF WEO world real GDP growth less latest World Bank population growth, flagged is_estimate; per worker left NULL
decisions.detail: the IMF WEO is the standard published source for the current year; no free published world employment growth to carry output per worker

notes: the last comparison did not establish the results were kept or changed only as expected for: fct_wait_milestones (firewall_refused), fct_world_output_daily (firewall_refused)
